name: Harvested
detailed_description:
Harvested

The world has fallen to alien conquerors, leaving humanity struggling to survive amidst the chaos. Harvested is a gripping multiplayer survival experience set in a post-apocalyptic Earth, where every decision could mean life or death. Collect resources, build shelters, and fight for your survival against alien threats and rival survivors in a immersive world ravaged by war.

Tactical Game-play

Comparing Harvested to other competitive survival games, it aims to achieve tactical and strategic gunfights. You can prefer silenced weapons with extra light clothes, use night vision gadgets to turn dark as a benefit, prepare traps around the battle zone, build your gadgets and weapons at the fight zone before storm rise and more..

Signal System

Signal system adds an extra layer of depth to tactical gameplay. Signals will work as the main aspect of the game and will be used for communication, navigation, locating air drops and events, jamming devices, prevent offline raids and use both defensive and offensive.

Dynamic Survival

Manage hunger, stamina and temperature. Use specific items to heal specific injuries. Build unique bases with using environmental features, and store tons of loot.

Inventory & Loot

There is no better mechanic than looting a fellow player's all hard work and tears. We love loot, so designed a grid based inventory that you can organize your items in a strategic way and simply provide a more realistic feeling when you carry your equipment.

Multiplayer Mayhem

Call your buddy, because Harvested is a hell.

Quest Line

All maps will be designed carefully and with full of details. Hang around, or follow the NPC quest line. It features boss fights, puzzles and lots of rare loots.

Will you thrive in the alien's shadow or succumb to the Harvest?

Wish-list Now and Prepare for the Ultimate Fight to Survive!
